explanation: An infinite period of time in which God exists, without beginning or end.
A place or person where one seeks safety and protection; here referring to God as humanity's protector and support.
A group of people born and living at approximately the same time, often used to describe a period characterized by a specific group of people.
A unit of time representing one orbit of the Earth around the sun, used to measure time and the course of life.
God's strong displeasure or anger, often directed toward human sin and disobedience.
The ability to think and act with knowledge, experience, understanding, and good judgment; something Psalm 90 asks God to teach humanity.
Effort and activities carried out by people, either physically or mentally, to reach a goal or achieve something.
God's radiant and overwhelming presence, which people desire to see and experience in their lives and work.
